First, 35 weeks + 6 days = 35 × 7 + 6 = 245 + 6 = 251 days.  

Start date: 1434-10-23 (Gregorian).  

Add 251 days:  
1434 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100 in Gregorian).  
Days left in Oct 1434: 31 - 23 = 8 → 251 - 8 = 243 left.  
Nov 1434: 30 days → 243 - 30 = 213 left.  
Dec 1434: 31 days → 213 - 31 = 182 left.  
Jan 1435: 31 days → 182 - 31 = 151 left.  
Feb 1435: 28 days (1435 not divisible by 4) → 151 - 28 = 123 left.  
Mar 1435: 31 days → 123 - 31 = 92 left.  
Apr 1435: 30 days → 92 - 30 = 62 left.  
May 1435: 31 days → 62 - 31 = 31 left.  
Jun 1435: 30 days → 31 - 30 = 1 left.  
Add 1 day to 1435-07-01 → 1435-07-02.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1435-07-02
